description: This file contains the implementation of the LocationService interface for managing Location entities in the OpenMRS platform. It includes methods for CRUD operations, retrieving locations by various criteria, managing location tags and attribute types, and handling location-specific configurations.

classes.name: LocationServiceImpl
classes.description: Default implementation of the LocationService interface for managing location data in OpenMRS.

methods.name: setLocationDAO
methods.description: Sets the DAO object used for database interactions related to Locations.

methods.name: saveLocation
methods.description: Saves a Location entity after validation and handling of transient tags.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Retrieves a Location by its integer ID.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Retrieves a Location by its name.

methods.name: getDefaultLocation
methods.description: Returns the default Location based on global properties or first available.

methods.name: getLocationByUuid
methods.description: Fetches a Location using its UUID.

methods.name: getLocationTagByUuid
methods.description: Fetches a LocationTag by UUID.

methods.name: getAllLocations
methods.description: Returns all Location objects, including retired if specified.

methods.name: getLocations
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Locations matching specified criteria.

methods.name: getRootLocations
methods.description: Gets top-level Locations that have no parent.

methods.name: getPossibleAddressValues
methods.description: Stub for retrieving possible address component values, not implemented by default.

methods.name: getAllLocationAttributeTypes
methods.description: Returns all LocationAttributeType objects.

methods.name: getLocationAttributeType
methods.description: Fetches a LocationAttributeType by its ID.

methods.name: getLocationAttributeTypeByUuid
methods.description: Fetches a LocationAttributeType by UUID.

methods.name: saveLocationAttributeType
methods.description: Saves or updates a LocationAttributeType.

methods.name: retireLocationAttributeType
methods.description: Retires a LocationAttributeType (though implementation appears incomplete).

methods.name: unretireLocationAttributeType
methods.description: Unretires and saves a LocationAttributeType.

methods.name: purgeLocationAttributeType
methods.description: Deletes a LocationAttributeType.

methods.name: getLocationAttributeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a LocationAttribute by UUID.

methods.name: getAddressTemplate
methods.description: Returns the address template string from global properties.

methods.name: saveAddressTemplate
methods.description: Sets the global property for address template.

methods.name: getLocationTag
methods.description: Gets a LocationTag by ID.

methods.name: getLocationTagByName
methods.description: Fetches a LocationTag by name.

methods.name: getAllLocationTags
methods.description: Returns all LocationTags, including retired if specified.

methods.name: getLocationTags
methods.description: Searches for LocationTags matching a search string.

methods.name: retireLocationTag
methods.description: Retires a LocationTag with a reason.

methods.name: unretireLocationTag
methods.description: Unretires and saves a LocationTag.

methods.name: purgeLocationTag
methods.description: Deletes a LocationTag.

methods.name: getCountOfLocations
methods.description: Returns the count of Locations matching criteria.

methods.name: getLocations
methods.description: Retrieves Locations based on various filters, including attributes.

methods.name: getRootLocations
methods.description: Fetches root Locations, optionally including retired.

methods.name: getLocationsHavingAllTags
methods.description: Retrieves Locations that have all specified tags.

methods.name: getLocationsHavingAnyTag
methods.description: Retrieves Locations that have any of the specified tags.

methods.name: retireLocation
methods.description: Marks a Location as retired with a reason.

methods.name: unretireLocation
methods.description: Unretires a Location.

methods.name: purgeLocation
methods.description: Deletes a Location.
